name: human-collaboration
description: Human-in-the-loop discipline. artifact-plan is the primary surface: one published HTML page is the plan, the context, every operator ask, the monitoring log and the handoff — it replaces all other planning methods. Plus read-only-default, diagnostic-mode-on-question, host-environment, docs/explain. Install on instances where a human drives the prompts. Do NOT install on autonomous dispatched workers.
